name: Intermediary 9
definition: Party that provides services to investors relating to financial products.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the intermediary.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer.

OrderOriginatorEligibility.name: Order Originator Eligibility
OrderOriginatorEligibility.definition: Counterparties eligibility as defined by article 24 of the EU MiFID Directive applicable to transactions executed by investment firms for eligible counterparties.

TradingPartyCapacity.name: Trading Party Capacity
TradingPartyCapacity.definition: Capacity of the party executing an order.

OrderOriginatorEligibility1Rule.definition: OrderOriginatorEligibility may only be present if Role is either UCL1 or UCL2.

RoleOrExtendedRoleRule.definition: Either Role or ExtendedRole may be present, but not both.
